nodes.Name: Cmdline
nodes.DocComment:
Cmdline responds with the running program's
command line, with arguments separated by NUL bytes.
The package initialization registers it as /debug/pprof/cmdline.

nodes.Name: Profile
nodes.DocComment:
Profile responds with the pprof-formatted cpu profile.
Profiling lasts for duration specified in seconds GET parameter, or for 30 seconds if not specified.
The package initialization registers it as /debug/pprof/profile.

nodes.Name: Trace
nodes.DocComment:
Trace responds with the execution trace in binary form.
Tracing lasts for duration specified in seconds GET parameter, or for 1 second if not specified.
The package initialization registers it as /debug/pprof/trace.

nodes.Name: Symbol
nodes.DocComment:
Symbol looks up the program counters listed in the request,
responding with a table mapping program counters to function names.
The package initialization registers it as /debug/pprof/symbol.

nodes.Name: Handler
nodes.DocComment:
Handler returns an HTTP handler that serves the named profile.
Available profiles can be found in [runtime/pprof.Profile].

nodes.Name: profileSupportsDelta
nodes.ValueLiteral: map[handler]bool{"allocs": true, "block": true, "goroutineleak": true, "goroutine": true, "heap": true, "mutex": true, "threadcreate": true}

nodes.ValueLiteral: map[string]string{"allocs": "A sampling of all past memory allocations", "block": "Stack traces that led to blocking on synchronization primitives", "cmdline": "The command line invocation of the current program", "goroutine": "Stack traces of all current goroutines. nodes.Name: Index
nodes.DocComment:
Index responds with the pprof-formatted profile named by the request.
For example, "/debug/pprof/heap" serves the "heap" profile.
Index responds to a request for "/debug/pprof/" with an HTML page
listing the available profiles.
